To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a system that allows for real-time rendering of procedurally generated city models with a very high level of detail while still relying on low memory footprints.

we present a real time system to render procedural facades with a high level quality on the graphics card, that we are able to generate lots of different facaded buildings by using a small grammar, that we are using ray casting for rendering transparent windows and that we are able render rooms that are generated on the fly.

(1) we present an efficient and scalable method for the real time rendering of virtual city models, (2) the presented approach is able to generate complex facades on the fly using a grammar description that can be stored in memory, (3) we use a ray casting approach to reveal the interior of buildings, and (4) the presented system enables the rendering of city models at high quality with a small amount of persistent memory.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of an efficient and flexible method for the procedural generation of facades and their real time rendering.
the real time rendering of procedural city models on the GPU, with an emphasis on the rendering of facades.
a real time approach that combines procedural texture generation with the rendering of virtual city models.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we are able to render a city of 100,000 buildings in real time, with a level of detail comparable to a high quality city model.
the presented approach is a good compromise between memory consumption and rendering performance.
our approach is able to generate realistic facades with a high level-of-detail while still keeping memory usage and rendering performance at a reasonable level.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the presented approach enables the creation of virtual worlds with a high level detail while still relying on small memory footprint.
we are able to generate a huge variety of facades with a small grammar and a small memory footprint.
we have created a procedural facade system that is capable of rendering high detailed city models with a very small memory footprint.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the presented system is able to produce realistic facades in real time while still being memory efficient.
we can generate a high quality city model on the fly by using a small set of rules that describe the building blocks of the city model.
the use of procedural methods can greatly increase the realism and complexity of a city model without increasing the memory footprint.
